anomalies.observed: Two microcontrollers, U1 (ATtiny13V-10S) and U4 (ATtiny45-20P), are both present and have all corresponding I/O and power pins connected in parallel on the same nets.
anomalies.expected: A single ATtiny-driven fan controller should have only one microcontroller populated. The second MCU is an extra component that will cause bus contention and possible damage if both are populated.
anomalies.impact: If both U1 and U4 are populated, they will drive the same I/O lines simultaneously, causing bus contention, excessive current, and unreliable operation. Programming via the shared ISP header would also be unreliable because both devices would respond.

parsed.summary: The design contains two microcontrollers (U1 and U4) with all pins connected in parallel, which is an extra component that would cause bus contention and malfunction if both are populated.
